verdict.rationale: Headless or CI use is a fair question for a GPU, since GPUs commonly serve as compute accelerators in automated pipelines. The evidence shows a programmatic compute stack (CUDA Toolkit, cuTile Python/C++ kernels, Nsight profiling tools), and benchmarks run as CUDA/OpenCL/Vulkan compute workloads, which implies the card can be driven by code rather than a GUI. Nothing explicitly documents headless or display-less operation or CI integration. Missing for 10: explicit headless/server-mode documentation, CI runner or container integration, CLI management/monitoring tooling, and hands-on reports of automated or CI use.
